name: svg-figure
description: Use when the user wants an explanatory figure hand-drawn as SVG and delivered as .svg and .png files (or inline in an HTML page): structure and flow sketches, before/after and option comparisons, physical objects with parts and sensor coverage, motion paths, step-by-step scenes. Flat editorial style where colour is a token that means state (decided, new, risk, proposal) and one drawing reads in light and dark; bundled checker, light/dark/phone preview sheet and exporter. Not AWS-specific. Korean triggers: 그림 그려줘, SVG로 그려줘, 설명 그림, 개념도, 도해, 구조도, 전후 비교 그림, 센서 배치도, 회의록 그림 스타일.
